text: The reliability dashboard from lesson seven tracks pods and latency, but it's never had a cost lens, or a direct comparison against the one thing grain-ingest actually feeds: Azure SQL.
We add an Azure Cost Management budget through Terraform, with a forecasted-spend alert, so finance hears about a cost trend early, not after the invoice arrives.
Then we add one new panel: pod count and estimated cost plotted next to Azure SQL's DTU usage, on the same time axis. When scaling works correctly, all three lines should rise together.
We validate it against a clean synthetic load burst, and all three climb in step, exactly as expected. Nobody suspects anything is wrong yet.
This panel isn't built because of an incident. It's built as good FinOps hygiene -- and it happens to be the only thing on this platform that could ever catch what's coming.
